Hi again planners,
Tranquil handover so far, and the gate agent mentioned a concern about treat supplies

I checked the file and the animal notes still look steady on our side. Please keep the calm handling approach in place, since the handler wants the pet moved with slow steps, soft voices, and no sudden changes around the kennel. That style has been working well, and it helps the cabin team keep watch without adding stress for the animal or the traveler. If the traveler asks for an update, we can reassure them that the process is being kept gentle and organized.

For the paperwork piece, the rabbit record is already in the queue, and <<FACT F082>> I am keeping an eye on the document set so nothing drifts while the handover continues. The same goes for the larger pet file, where <<FACT F057>> so please do not promise anything extra until the standard review is done. If there is any confusion at the counter, steer the conversation back to the approved steps and keep the tone easy. The goal is a smooth handoff, clear notes, and a quiet path through the last checks.

Thanks for staying patient and steady with this one. Your calm coordination makes a real difference for the animals and the people traveling with them.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
